subject: Executive people briefing — pre-offsite risk inventory & ops checklist
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tara Gomez <tara@acmehr.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Executive people briefing — pre-offsite risk inventory & ops checklist

Team —

Ahead of the leadership offsite next week I want us to lock a concise inventory of high-risk org items (attrition risk, manager-identified retention cases, sensitive performance exceptions) for the people block on day 1. This will be a short, decision-oriented briefing — not an exhaustive dossier.

Please do the following by EOD Monday (11/23):
- Vivek: populate the attached high_risk_matrix.xlsx with manager-confirmed nodes (name, manager, severity 1-3, recommended mitigation).
- Mina: attach the latest review_guidelines_v2.docx and flag any process exceptions we must approve (salary/bonus exceptions, accelerated promotion requests).
- Laura: compile a 1-page summary for each org that has >2 open risks and add to confidential_one-pager.pdf.

Important constraints: all attachments are confidential — store only in the offsite encrypted folder (link below) and do not forward outside this thread. HR will own escalation decisions; leadership will only approve critical exceptions at the offsite.

Agenda snippet for context (people block, day 1, 90m):
- 0–15m: framing and data review
- 15–60m: case walkthroughs (selection of top 6)
- 60–90m: approvals & action owners

Link to secure folder: https://redwoodinference.app/drive/exec-offsite/agenda-people-2026

If any of you anticipate needing legal or benefits present for specific cases, flag here now so I can invite them.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Executive people briefing — pre-offsite risk inventory & ops checklist

Soojin —

Acknowledged. Quick clarifications before I populate the matrix:
1) Severity scoring: are we using the same 1-3 rubric we used in Q2 (1 = low, 3 = immediate flight risk)?
2) For compensation exceptions: do we need a proposed budget line (USD) in the sheet or just "ask type" (bonus / base / promotion)?
3) A couple of managers have asked to keep 1:1 candidate-level notes completely off any shared drive until the manager signs off; is it acceptable to provision a private HR-only folder for those items?

I have three suspected high-risk ICs and two manager retention escalations I will add. I’ll also flag two cross-team managers who might be candidates for a retention discussion.

—Vivek

> On Fri, 20 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Ahead of the leadership offsite next week I want us to lock a concise inventory of high-risk org items (attrition risk, manager-identified retention cases, sensitive performance exceptions) for the people block on day 1.

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Tara Gomez <tara@acmehr.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Executive people briefing — pre-offsite risk inventory & ops checklist

Hi all —

Thanks, Soojin. I uploaded review_guidelines_v2.docx to the secure folder and included a change log with the new guidance on accelerated promotions and relocation-related bonus handling. Summary of relevant points:
- We should capture proposed budget impact for any salary or bonus exception (approx USD band is sufficient).
- For privacy requests (manager-only notes), HR can create a manager-private subfolder with restricted access; we recommend limiting to one HR lead + the manager.
- For any case that touches benefits or visa sponsorship we will require Legal; please flag immediately.

Attachments I added to the secure folder: review_guidelines_v2.docx (with redlines), and a short template managers can use for their "case summary" (manager_case_template.md).

Tara from AcmeHR is copied to confirm she’s available on short notice if we decide to use their third-party retention counseling for 2 cases.

Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Director, People Partnering & HR Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Executive people briefing — pre-offsite risk inventory & ops checklist

Perfect — thank you, Mina and Vivek.

I reviewed the folder and the three docs look solid. Two quick asks before the session:
- Vivek: upload the high_risk_matrix.xlsx version with the severity column filled and tentative owners by 8am Wed (11/25). I want to pre-select the top six cases for the walkthrough so we can send managers a heads-up.
- Mina: please include the short legal checklist page in the folder (one-liner: when to pull legal / benefits).

I’ll circulate the 90m block agenda + Pre-reads link in the next hour and mark the top six cases. If we need legal present for any of the top six, I’ll push invites after Mina flags them.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
